Components / Surfaces

Filters drawer

.dr-sheet--tall · .dr-sheet__scroll · .dr-sheet__actions--row · components/sheet.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Filters

Drone type

Which drone does your order

Price range

Service price, all fees included

Minimum ₴0

Maximum ₴1,000+

  1. 1.dr-sheet--tallmax-height: calc(100% − 44px). A strip of the screen behind stays visible (HIG · Sheets), which shows the drawer is a layer over the page and not a new screen. Tapping the strip dismisses it. Measured 693.77 tall at the 375 × 812 frame.
  2. 2.dr-sheet__titleFilters, the name of the button that opened it.
  3. 3.dr-sheet__scrollOnly the middle scrolls: flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto. It bleeds the sheet's 16px gutter back with margin-inline: -16px and pads 4 / 16, so a focus ring at the edge is not clipped. The zones inside it stand 12 apart.
  4. 4.dr-zoneOne question per titled zone. Drone type is a fieldset of four checkbox rows, 341 × 274.
  5. 5.dr-rangeThe second zone, Price range, drawn by price range.
  6. 6.dr-sheet__actions--rowClear all and Apply filters side by side at equal widths. Neither of them is a cancel.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Tall drawer.

States

No state of its own: the drawer is a container, and its controls are other components. The rows take the checkbox and radio states, the two thumbs the price range states, and Clear all and Apply filters the button states.

When to use

The filters drawer is the second drawer listings opens and the only one that holds more than fits. The Filters button on the finder raises it. It holds Drone type and the price range, and at the built frame it has 0px to scroll. The scroll body exists for when zones are added later. Applied values come back to the home screen as filter chips above Filters (see in-page tabs), and a tap on a chip removes that filter.

Apply filters writes the chips and closes. Clear all empties every zone and closes. The scrim and Escape close without applying. The two actions sit side by side because neither is a cancel. The stacked-cancel rule from HIG · Action sheets applies to a Cancel / Done pair, and this is not one. The four drone type names (Quadcopter · Hexacopter · FPV · Fixed-wing) are equipment words. They depart from voice P4 and P1 on the designer's decision.

Four screens build it with the same markup: listings, listings-loading, listings-filters and listings-error. On listings and listings-loading nothing is picked and the band is ₴0 – ₴1,000+. On listings-filters and listings-error Hexacopter is ticked and the minimum is ₴600. Only the values differ.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The search home (Drawers) · inventory.md § 1 Tall drawer · microcopy.md § listings, Filters drawer · ui/kit.html § Filters drawer

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Two actions that each change the result, Clear all and Apply filters, side by side at the drawer's foot. Apply filters is the drawer's one green control.

Don’t

Cancel and Done split across one row. A pair that includes a cancel stacks one per row, Done over Cancel, the way every Done/Cancel drawer does; see stacked actions. A drawer whose content fits without scrolling does not need --tall. Use the plain sheet.
